name: URTC-VISION-TOOL
build: bash build_firmware.sh. Also contains an independent Python vision companion package (cd src/vision_companion && pip install -e '.[dev]' && pytest).
notes: Firmware itself is still an unverified skeleton pending a real PCB. The Python vision_companion package is real and test-covered: synthetic thermal+RGB frame generation, false-color rendering, and (new) real RGB->thermal ROI alignment + temperature-stats extraction (alignment.py), all verified by 21 real pytest cases. Real dual-modal (RGB + thermal) capture and per-pixel sensor calibration still need a real PCB and real cameras.
